entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 11, signed by 𝔓11, is a copy of a part of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the First Epistle to the Corinthians. It contains fragments 1 Corinthians 1:17–22; 2:9–12.14; 3:1–3,3:5–6; 4:3; 5:5–5.7–8; 6:5–9.11–18; 7:3–6.10–11.12–14. Only some portions of the codex can be read. Papyrus 11 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
